meta.topic: Website + traffic / the net and the water

yt_title.hi: Sirf website se customers nahi aate. Website jaal hai, traffic paani #shorts
yt_title.en: A website alone won't bring customers. It's a net, not the water #shorts

yt_description.hi: Website machhli pakadne ka jaal hai. Paani teen jagah hai: ads, Google aur social media. Dono chahiye.
yt_description.en: A website is a fishing net. The water is in three places: ads, Google and social media. You need both.

ig_caption.hi:
Hum websites banate hain, aur hum hi bol rahe hain: sirf website se customers nahi aate. 🎣

Website = jaal
Traffic = paani

💸 Ads: paisa lagta hai
🔎 Google: time lagta hai
📱 Social media: mehnat lagti hai

Jaal bina paani: sookha. Paani bina jaal: paisa paani mein.

Aapki website par log kahaan se aate hain? Comment karo 👇

Voiceover is AI-generated.
ig_caption.en:
We build websites, and even we'll say it: a website alone won't bring customers. 🎣

Website = the net
Traffic = the water

💸 Ads cost money
🔎 Google takes time
📱 Social media takes effort

A net with no water stays dry. Water with no net is money down the drain.

Where do your website visitors come from? Comment 👇

Voiceover is AI-generated.

say.hi: हम websites बनाते हैं, और हम ही बोल रहे हैं: सिर्फ website से customers नहीं आते।
say.en: We build *websites*, and even we'll say it: a website alone *won't bring customers*.

show.hi: Hum *websites* banate hain, aur hum hi bol rahe hain: sirf website se *customers nahi aate*.

say.hi: Website मछली पकड़ने का जाल है। जाल कितना भी अच्छा हो, उसे पानी में डालना पड़ता है।
say.en: A website is a *fishing net*. However good the net is, you have to put it *in the water*.

show.hi: Website machhli pakadne ka *jaal* hai. Jaal kitna bhi achha ho, use *paani mein* daalna padta hai.

say.hi: पानी तीन जगह है। Ads, जहाँ पैसा लगता है। Google, जहाँ time लगता है। और social media, जहाँ मेहनत लगती है।
say.en: The water is in *three* places. *Ads*, which cost money. *Google*, which takes time. And *social media*, which takes effort.

show.hi: Paani *teen* jagah hai. *Ads*, jahaan paisa lagta hai. *Google*, jahaan time lagta hai. Aur *social media*, jahaan mehnat lagti hai.

say.hi: जिसने सिर्फ website बनाई और बैठ गया, उसके पास एक सुंदर जाल है। सूखा।
say.en: Whoever just built a website and sat back has a beautiful net. *Bone dry.*

show.hi: Jisne *sirf* website banayi aur baith gaya, uske paas ek sundar jaal hai. *Sookha.*

say.hi: लोग ad से आए, website ने rate दिखाया, भरोसा दिया, button दिया, तब वो customer बने।
say.en: People came from an *ad*. The website showed the *price*, built *trust*, gave them a *button*. Then they became *customers*.

show.hi: Log *ad* se aaye, website ne *rate* dikhaya, *bharosa* diya, *button* diya, tab wo *customer* bane.

say.hi: दोनों चाहिए। अकेली website कुछ नहीं, और बिना website के ad का पैसा पानी में।
say.en: You need *both*. A website alone does nothing, and ads without a website are *money down the drain*.

show.hi: *Dono chahiye.* Akeli website kuch nahi, aur bina website ke ad ka *paisa paani mein*.

say.hi: आपकी website पर लोग कहाँ से आते हैं? पता नहीं, तो comment में लिखो: पता नहीं।
say.en: Where do people find your website? Don't know? *Comment* *don't know*.

show.hi: Aapki website par log *kahaan se* aate hain? Pata nahi, toh *comment* mein likho: *pata nahi*.

say.hi: Website चाहिए? DM या email करो।
